facts.title: Tilebit - Component & Inspiration Library
facts.description: Tilebit is a lightweight component and inspiration library. Find 500+ components built for Webflow, Figma, and Framer. Find 1000+ inspirations linked to our wireframe kit.

research.name: Tilebit
research.note: 500+ wireframe-style website sections to copy into Figma, Framer or Webflow, plus an inspiration library.
unverified: No dated change was found: the site mentions a v2.0 launch and 300 components coming this summer without dates, and the sitemap and pages carry no usable date.
